thread:
ellie: Quick pitch  Lighthouse microseries: 15m demo + benchmark note + 48h drip. Offer: 600 tokens at signup, 400 on attendance. Goal: +12% first-api-call within 72h.

marc: sounds good. timeline? we need landing + tracking by Tue so growth can seed Wed.

toni: UX rec: auto-apply 600 at signup, attendee modal for the 400 claim. include a tiny runnable prompt and a "Run with credits" CTA inside the modal.

guillermo: agree. add a one-click sample runner that inserts api key placeholder and example snippet for Python/JS. keeps dev friction low.

kira: copy A/B for subject lines: A) "Run a prompt today  1,000 free tokens" B) "Starter prompts + credits for builders". split 60/40 favor A.

growth-bot: Channels recommended: Twitter devs, GH placements, newsletter. Budget estimate: $2k. Suggest canary 20% for variant B.

ellie: measurement plan: funnel events - registrant, attendee, credit_claimed, first_api_call. dashboard owner: kira + analytics.

analytics-bot: Event `lighthouse_credit_claimed` added with props ["utm_campaign","cohort","variant","attended","utm_source"]. Funnel tile queued.

marc: landing query string for devs: `?utm_source={{channel}}&utm_campaign=lighthouse_1019&cohort={{cohort}}&variant={{variant}}`. will add canary flag.

toni: creative ask: hero banner, 3 social variants (launch, reminder, highlight), 2 email templates, and a 4-prompt starter kit (summarize, refactor, extract, embed-search). Tone: developer-first, actionable.

guillermo: privacy note: credits valid on hosted API only. add a short line on landing and claim modal: "Hosted API credits only. Contact AE for Private deployments."

kira: onboarding nudge: if user claims but doesn't run a prompt within 48h, trigger in-app toast + email with direct "Run sample prompt" link that executes once. reduce churn.

ops-bot: Preview: https://preview.redwood.app/lighthouse-1019 (expires 48h).

marc: PR will be posted to `git.internal/redwood/marketing/lighthouse-1019` by Mon. please review for tracking and cohort params.

ellie: action recap: marc=landing+PR, toni=UX+modal, guillermo=prompt kit+snippets, kira=copy+email variants+dashboard owner, growth-bot=channels+budget. Sync Tue for final go/no-go. :sparkles:
